**Machine Learning | LLMs & Agentic AI | Biomedical Data Science & Healthcare**

Hi there, welcome to my website.

### My story

I am a data scientist with 7+ years of bioinformatics engineering experience, now focusing on applied AI and machine learning. My work has always lived where data is noisy, high-dimensional, and consequential: clinical genomics, translational research, diagnostics, and healthcare analytics. A concise summary of this work is available on the [Bioinformatics](bioinformatics.qmd) page.

**My move toward AI and machine learning** comes from both long-standing curiosity and a clear professional direction: intelligent systems are becoming central to scientific discovery, healthcare, and real-world decision support. I am especially interested in building models that are robust, interpretable, and useful beyond benchmarks.

Since fall 2025, I have been pursuing an MSc in Computer Science at Leiden University, specializing in Data Science. Building on my experience in biomedical research and data science, I am now **particularly interested in LLMs, agentic AI, and trustworthy information retrieval, especially their applications in healthcare**.


### Key focus areas

- **Large Language Models & Agentic AI** — RAG, reasoning, and uncertainty-aware decision-making
- **Machine Learning & Trustworthy AI** — deep learning, model evaluation, and reliability
- **Biomedical AI & Healthcare Data Science** — medical AI applications, clinical data analysis, and predictive modeling
- **Bioinformatics & Computational Genomics** — clinical genomics, biomarker discovery, and multi-omics analysis

### Education

- MSc Data Science (Computer Science) - Leiden University, The Netherlands (2025–2027)
- MSc Bioinformatics - The University of Edinburgh, UK (2015–2016)
- BEng Biomedical Engineering - Northeastern University, China (2011–2015)

**Key Courses**
